newsitem.title: USA: Massachusetts January jobless rate 4.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Massachusetts January jobless rate 4.0 pct.

text.p: The Massachusetts unemployment rate for January was 4.0 percent, up slightly from December's revised 3.9 percent figure, the state's Division of Employment and Training reported on Friday.

The state showed an estimated 6,100 less jobs over the month from December to January, but the total of 3,069,800 showed a gain of 74,900 more jobs from a year before in January 1996, the division said.
The national rate for January was 5.4 percent, up from 5.3 percent in December.
"The average unemployment rate for 1996 was 4.3 percent, considerably lower than the 5.4 average annual rate for 1995," the division's deputy director Nils Nordberg said in a statement.

The new unemployment rate model uses a combination of data from the Current Population Survey, the Current Employment Statistics and the unemployment insurance system, the division said. The seasonally adjusted CPS data shows a labor force of 3,214,800 employed Massachusetts residents and 130,000 unemployed in January.
